item.title: Registered nurses in Mississippi can apply for loan assistance through state program
item.description: Nurses in Mississippi with student loan debt could be granted financial relief. The Mississippi Office of Student Financial Aid offers registered nurses and licensed practical nurses with outstanding student loan debt an opportunity to apply for up to $6,000 in loan repayment through the Nurse Retention Loan Repayment program. This will be the program’s last […]

item.title: Man accused of setting fire to Mississippi’s oldest synagogue facing new federal charges
item.description: The 19-year-old who admitted to setting Mississippi’s oldest synagogue is facing new federal charges. On Tuesday, Stephen Spencer Pittman was charged by superseding indictment with civil rights and arson offenses related to the burning of the Beth Israel Congregation in Jackson. He had previously just been charged with arson by the Justice Department, and is […]

item.title: SuperTalk Eagle Hour 2/12/2026
item.description: Landen Payne, former Southern Miss pitcher, and recently drafted by the Chicago White Sox, joins Bob, and Kelly in studio. Plus, Mark Patton, Noozhawk Sports Columnist, talks baseball opening weekend matchup between the Golden ages and UC Santa Barbara.

item.description: An investigation is underway after a fisherman spotted a dead body floating in the Pearl River. item.title: Starkville Derby bringing back world’s largest wiener dog race in April
item.description: The Starkville Derby, tabbed the world’s largest wiener dog race and festival, is set to return this spring. item.title: Team Hope Walk returning to Flowood to raise awareness, funds for Huntington’s disease
item.description: The fifth annual Team Hope Walk is set for Saturday, May 2, in Flowood, an event that raises awareness and research funding for Huntington’s disease. item.title: Starkville poaches West Point’s Brett Morgan as head football coach
item.description: It didn’t take long for Starkville High School to find its next head football coach after John Carr accepted an NFL gig. item.title: T&L Extra: Jonathan Holder on His Dudy Noble Memories, the Bench Mobb, and Johnny Cash
item.description: In 2013, Mississippi State’s opponents knew when they heard the deep voice of Johnny Cash, the game was about to be over as Jonathan Holder was taking the mound. The former Diamond Dawg closer joins Brian Hadad to stroll down Memory Lane and the crazy cast of characters he played with.

item.title: Thunder & Lightning: Opening Day is Finally Here For Mississippi State Baseball
item.description: Months of waiting, excitement, and anticipation finally come to an end today, as Mississippi State begins the Brian O’Connor Era and the 2026 season. Brian Hadad and Robbie Faulk put the finishing touches of weeks of baseball talk with their 2026 preview.
